node.statement: The inequalities t <= W.e_cross <= e_cross^0 <= e_zero allow lem-maincb-cross-union-zero-corners to be applied to the fixed datum. Hence dim S^{A_R}_{P_U^R,P_V^R}=dim S^{A_R}_{P_V^R,P_U^R}=0, so both target cross-corners equal the zero vector space. Also B_R=B_U oplus B_V with q_U=(I_{B_U},0) and q_V=(0,I_{B_V}) gives q_U B_R q_V=q_V B_R q_U={0} by coordinatewise multiplication in a direct sum.
